description: The unchanged HF integration example imports an export removed by this commit.
trigger: Run examples/transformers_integration.py in an environment where its preceding imports succeed.
expected_behavior: The example obtains patch_transformers and registers EXL3 before loading the model.
actual_behavior: Its `from exllamav3.integration import patch_transformers` requests a name no longer defined by the empty initializer, preventing the subsequent registration call and main execution.
